environment.description: Same application deployed in an EKS pod with a custom seccomp profile loaded via the node's /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/renderer-strict.json. The profile operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode for the execve and execveat syscalls (numbers 59 and 322 on x86_64) EXCEPT when the binary path matches /usr/bin/wkhtmltopdf exactly (via SCMP_CMP_EQ on arg0 resolved through the kernel's bprm->filename). Additionally, the container runs with a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true) with an emptyDir volume mounted at /tmp. The pod's securityContext sets allowPrivilegeEscalation: false and drops ALL capabilities then adds only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. A Kyverno ClusterPolicy (audit+enforce) validates that no pod in the namespace can override the seccomp annotation. The container's PATH is set to /usr/bin only.
